How we work

Make the useful thing feel good to use.

We care about the details that turn model capability into a product: the shape of a workspace, the quality of an interface, the clarity of a voice, and the control people have over the systems they use.

Expressive

Our products

MoCHi is our primary product: a personal AI workspace built around user-controlled providers, memory, files, tools and workflows. Haven is a voice / TTS infrastructure system in development for natural AI speech, Read Aloud and future real-time experiences.
